112: class MoleculeBackbone(nn.Module):
113:     """Bond-aware residual GINE + trainable virtual node; original atom/bond fields.
114: 
115:     An explicit contemporary baseline adaptation, not a reproduced OGB table.
116:     Node LayerNorm avoids mixing one member's normalization state with another.
117:     """
118:     def __init__(self, options):
119:         super().__init__()
120:         d, layers, p = options["hidden"], options["layers"], options["dropout"]
121:         self.atom = AtomEncoder(d)
122:         self.input = nn.Linear(d, d)
123:         self.bonds = nn.ModuleList([BondEncoder(d) for _ in range(layers)])
124:         self.norms = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d) for _ in range(layers)])
125:         self.convs = nn.ModuleList([GINEConv(nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 2*d), nn.ReLU(),
126:             nn.Dropout(p), nn.Linear(2*d, d)), train_eps=True) for _ in range(layers)])
127:         self.virtual = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, d))
128:         self.virtual_mlps = nn.ModuleList([nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 2*d), nn.ReLU(),
129:             nn.Linear(2*d, d)) for _ in range(layers - 1)])
130:         self.output_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
131:         self.head = nn.Linear(d, 1)
132:         self.dropout = p
133:         self.message_factors = None
134:         self.member = 0
135: 
136:     def enable_message_factors(self, members):
137:         self.message_factors = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(len(self.convs), members, self.input.weight.shape[0]))
138: 
139:     @property
140:     def stem(self):
141:         return self.input
142: 
143:     def forward(self, batch):
144:         graph = batch["graph"]
145:         if graph.x.dtype != torch.long or graph.x.shape[1] != 9 or graph.edge_attr.dtype != torch.long or graph.edge_attr.shape[1] != 3:
146:             raise ValueError("Complete original OGB chemical categorical fields required")
147:         assignment = graph.batch
148:         graphs = int(graph.num_graphs)
149:         h = F.relu(self.input(self.atom(graph.x)))
150:         virtual = self.virtual.expand(graphs, -1)
151:         for i, (conv, bond, norm) in enumerate(zip(self.convs, self.bonds, self.norms)):
152:             message = norm(h + virtual[assignment])
153:             if self.message_factors is not None:
154:                 message = message * self.message_factors[i, self.member]
155:             # Private channels enter GINE's relu(x_j + bond) BEFORE sum aggregation.
156:             update = conv(message, graph.edge_index, bond(graph.edge_attr))
157:             h = h + F.dropout(F.relu(update), self.dropout, self.training)
158:             if i < len(self.convs) - 1:
159:                 virtual = virtual + F.dropout(self.virtual_mlps[i](
160:                     global_add_pool(h, assignment, size=graphs) + virtual), self.dropout, self.training)
161:         representation = global_mean_pool(self.output_norm(h), assignment, size=graphs)
162:         return self.head(representation), representation
